requirements.MHR02: Apply the best-fitting height consistently to navigation, profile and Settings; review logo, wallet, divider and car alignment.

decision.reason: 56px retains the original 23px labels and a 48px car picture with 4px vertical insets, while unifying the controls and recovering 10px of page height. The 52px candidate needs a smaller 44px car picture; 60/64px give a heavier row. This is a visual judgment from desktop captures.
other_components: Logo gets the same 56px frame; existing widths and aspect-preserving drawing remain.
Wallet stays unboxed with the original 24px coin and label treatment; its centre is within 1px of account/control centres.
Divider retains its quiet original wallet-height line.
Settings has a 56x56 touch target and its original glyph.
Car image is 48px tall at both width tiers with 4px of vertical inset.
Account retains the existing 174/210px width tiers; long names ellipsize and remain complete in the Profile tooltip.
Matching vertical padding in normal, hover, pressed, disabled and focus styles prevents interaction-state text-placement changes.

baseline_long_name_case.description: Before the profile-width fix, a long driver-name fixture and 1,234,567 balance push Settings outside the viewport.
